notes.notes:
Reduced amount of actors (merging some actors to be components of existing actors).
Using GPU billboard materials instead of planes to save CPU.

General improvement and some progress towards multiplayer feature (No ETA on when the Actual feature is going to be released).

notes.title: Siezure of MacOS support.
notes.notes:
We are really sad to announce that we are no longer able to make new MacOS builds.
Unfortunately we lost the ability to build custom engine for the MacOS at this moment.
The game is going to be supported for Windows platforms only.

Mac users: we are really really sorry about that, we will keep trying to revive the Mac branch from time to time.

notes.title: Porting to UE4 4.24 (Windows only)
notes.notes:
We ported to newer Unreal Engine version (not the latest but we are working towards it).
Current binary is built using UE4 4.24.
We are planning to use new features to build multiplayer and optimize rendering.

Lots of bugs were fixed.

As this version of the game is using completely new engine, please report every bugs you see.
And we will try to fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: A long due update on Multiplayer and life.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

We wish to apologize for not posting an update for a while now. To be completely honest, our first child was born about a month ago (we're a couple) and so the game has been put aside lately for a bit.
We're still working on the game and the Multiplayer option is in its final stage. We still need to add some graphics and do some final testing, but it's definitely happening and we didn't neglect it.
So we're doing our best to find the time to finish the multiplayer update as we raise our child, which is a tough task :)
Rest assured - we didn't abandon the project, we're just taking a bit more time.

Also, as you noticed, we're still making bug fixed and small features and updating regularly.
We also reply to any mail or post, doing our best to support the community.

So please bare with us a little bit more :)

Thank you again for your support and concern.
Liron & Roma.

notes.title: Update: New Feature & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've uploaded a new update that includes requested features and several bug fixes:

[h3]New Feature:[/h3]

The alchemist can now pick up mines that he placed on the ground and place them in a different location. This was a request by many so we add it just for you.
Mines count is still limited, so use them wisely.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

We fixed several bugs in the game.
Please report to us of any bugs you find, either by posting in this group under "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1174670/discussions/1/]Questions / Report Issues[/url]" or through our [url=https://discord.gg/DFDxWKQ]Discord server[/url], where you can chat with us and get online support.

[h3]Coming Next:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Archers will step aside when blocking melee units even if they are shooting arrows.
[*] Un-merged formations rework.
[*] Pause without the popup menu and with ability to control units.
[*] We'll add hidden rewards throughout the game.
[*] And of course we're working on Multiplayer :)
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer is Coming to Nordic Warriors Soon
notes.notes:
You asked, we listened: We've started working on adding Steam Multiplayer to Nordic Warriors.

Since developing this will take some time, we'll start first by adding COOP mode.
That will allow you to host the game on your computer with your friends or other players (P2P).
It will take us several weeks to get it up and going, but we've already started and making progress.

The next step after coop will be adding PvP modes, and that will be several weeks after coop mode.

Since we're going to use Steam discovery services, you will have to buy the game on steam (or use a steam key) to play the multiplayer modes.
Those who have purchased the game outside of Steam (DRM free/App store) and don't have an access to steam key, fear not - we'll contact you when multiplayer is up.

We hope we've made some people happy with these news :)

notes.title: Update: New Features & Bug Fixes

notes.title: Demo will No longer be available
notes.notes:
We'll be removing the demo version of Nordic Warriors from Steam and other platforms from July 1st.
This means that new users will no longer be able to download our demo.
In addition, users who have already downloaded the demo from Steam will no longer be able to play it.
The demo will be deactivated and won't show on Steam.

We're doing this because the demo is no longer supported with bug fixes and new features, making it outdated and not representing Nordic Warriors the way we want to.
Updating the demo in addition to updating the full version is taking too much effort, and we prefer focusing our time making the game work better and add new features, so the users can enjoy the thrilling experience playing Nordic Warriors.

If you're still interested in taking a quick peak at our game, you can watch streamers online or read reviews about our game.

We hope you understand and we thank you for your support.

Nordic Warriors devs.
